extensionDescription.message: Live captions transcribed from the video's actual audio, word for word. Made for language learning.

commandToggle.message: Start/stop live captions on the current tab

fieldLanguageHelp.message: The language spoken in the videos.

optionsNote.message: Changes are saved automatically and apply the next time you start captions. API keys are stored only in this browser's extension storage.

shortcutHelp.message: Starts and stops captions on the current tab:

debugHelp.message: Displays how far behind the audio each caption appears. For troubleshooting.

audio_auto_help.message: The video on the page; the companion for DRM-protected videos.

audio_page_help.message: Reads the audio straight from the video. Doesn't work with DRM.

audio_tab_help.message: Always records through the companion, only Firefox's sound.

audio_system_help.message: Everything your speakers play. Use it if the tab's audio isn't found.

companionExplain.message: DRM-protected videos (Netflix, Disney+, Prime Video…) can't be read from the page. This small app, installed separately, records them from the sound output instead.

companion_missing.message: Only needed for DRM-protected videos. Download it, run it once, then click “Check again”.

companion_missing_linux.message: Only needed for DRM-protected videos. Download it, unpack it and run ./captions-companion install (needs PipeWire), then click “Check again”.

companion_outdated.message: An older version is installed. Install the latest one; it replaces the old one.

companion_broken.message: It's registered but Firefox couldn't start it ($1). Reinstalling usually fixes it.

companion_unsupported.message: The companion runs on Windows 10/11 and Linux. On this system only videos without DRM work.

providerDeepgramDescription.message: Fast and accurate streaming speech-to-text. Needs an API key from deepgram.com (free credit on signup).

providerLocalDescription.message: Whisper on your own machine: free and private, but slower. Start it with server/run.sh from the project's repository.

providerTestDescription.message: Shows the audio level instead of text, to check that audio capture works on a site.

fieldDeepgramKeyHelp.message: Create one in the Deepgram console → API Keys.

fieldDeepgramExtraHelp.message: Appended to the request URL. See the Deepgram streaming docs.

fieldApiTokenHelp.message: Only if the server was started with --api-token.

errorDeepgramKeyMissing.message: Deepgram API key missing — set it in the extension settings.

errorDeepgramModelLanguage.message: The API key is valid, but the model $1 doesn't support the language “$2”. Try another model.

errorDeepgramConnect.message: Could not connect to Deepgram. Check the API key, and that the model supports this language.

errorLocalConnect.message: Could not connect to $1. Is the local server running?

errorCompanionMissing.message: DRM-protected videos need the Captions companion app, which is not installed. Open the Captions toolbar button to get it.

errorUnknownProvider.message: Unknown provider “$1”. Pick one in the settings.

errorAudioBlocked.message: The browser blocked audio processing. Click the page and try again.

errorLostConnection.message: Lost connection to the extension. Toggle captions to retry.

errorVideoRemoved.message: The video was removed from the page.

popupUnavailable.message: Captions are not available on this page. If you just installed the extension, reload the tab.

popupNoVideo.message: No video found on this page.

popupNeedsAccess.message: The extension needs access to websites to read video audio.

popupAccessGranted.message: Access granted. Reload the tab to use captions.
